headline: Nobody notices clean. Everybody notices the day it slips.
hero_alt: Safety Facility Services cleaning crew on site
body_paragraph_1: Cleaning is the only service in your building that gets judged every single day and reported only when it fails. By the time a tenant emails you about the restroom, the program has been drifting for weeks.
body_paragraph_2: Drift is a management problem, not a mop problem. Ours is built so that the standard is written down, someone is accountable for it by name, and it gets checked before you have to.
point_1_body: Daily, periodic and deep-clean tasks written by area and frequency — so "clean" means the same thing to your team and ours.
point_2_body: Quality auditors inspect proactively and log what they find. You see the report whether or not anything was wrong.
point_3_body: Our teams work in Corrigo, ServiceChannel, FacilitySource and FEXA, so requests close where you already track them.
aside_body: Cleaning is a people business, and turnover is what breaks it. We hire selectively — only 5% of applicants are brought on — train through master trainers, and give every site a named account executive and client service manager rather than a queue.
cta_body: We'll walk the building, mark what the scope misses, and price the program against what your property actually needs.
